article.title: Offence committed by child under this Chapter.
article.content:
89Offence committed by child under this Chapter.

Section 89  ·  Chapter IX  ·  page 40 of the Act
Any child who commits any offence under this Chapter shall be considered as a child in conflict with law under this Act.
